design: All six sealed prior P1 seeds, including complete and unresolved, each assigned once to direct rewrite and audit+repair. No new extraction or seed selection. Paired post-hoc repair diagnostic, not an end-to-end fresh generation efficacy estimate. Extra audit call and context are bundled; not an isolated formatting effect.
request_policy: Same original P1 source/extraction input and draft for both final calls; same generic rewrite instruction. Only R1 adds full unedited audit JSON plus frozen suffix. Source authority precedes automatic extraction/audit. No evaluator requirements/scores in requests.
fixed_parameters: temperature=0, reasoning none, store false; final schema same and 2-4 sentences, max_output_tokens=900; audit max_output_tokens=3000
execution: Hash-ordered 12 slots, sequential. Audit immediately precedes repair. No retry/resume/filtering/editing of audit. Stop on transport/HTTP/model/usage/schema/incomplete/size/budget errors. Missing/duplicate IDs or unsupported audit labels are diagnostic, not selection. Preserve all slots.
evaluation: Coordinator manual primary assessment of 12 anonymized final outputs using unchanged nine requirements and 1/0/null, true/false/null rules; seal before reading new audit outputs or keys. Coordinator knows seed outputs and prior scores, so no independent/blinded review claim. Old seed scores remain unchanged.
diagnostic: After primary seal, inspect audit whether prior missing/distorted elements were flagged and whether final preserved them. Audit self-labels do not determine final success. Quote matching is diagnostic only.
candidate_gate: All 18 calls completed and 12 final explanations usable with input/output seals valid
R1 confirmed distorted+unresolved <= R0 confirmed distorted
No R0 confirmed complete paired seed regresses in R1
No previously confirmed complete seed regresses in R1
decision: At most FIRST_REVIEW_CANDIDATE, never unseen-clause authorization; otherwise IMPROVEMENT_NOT_CONFIRMED. Preserve previous HOLD. No automatic new trial, tuning, independent-agent review or unseen-clause run.
scope: 3 known developmental cases, six fixed drafts; descriptive comparisons and unresolved bounds only; no p-values/CI/generalization.
